adopt: Write one pack manifest over your master images and build a Discord, Telegram, Slack and post-ready bundle from it with one command.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
A sticker set made for Discord (320 px APNG under 512 KiB) is the wrong size, format and weight for Telegram (512 px WEBP), Slack (under 128 KB) and for a LinkedIn or X post (no sticker system at all, just a post-ready image plus alt text), so every app gets its own hand-resized copy and they drift apart.

Install
pip install awexpress

Commands
  awexpress

Quick start
  pip install -e. # Pillow is the only dependency

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awexpress/
synopsis: One expression pack of stickers, emoji, captions and sounds, compiled for every app.
